reason: 该插件的主要面向用户用途是为 DSH Desktop 提供系统托盘能力，包括托盘图标、最小化/关闭入托盘、托盘菜单显隐窗口与退出，并通过启动时自愈补丁在应用更新后恢复该能力，故归入桌面端交互体验类。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘支持，可在最小化或关闭时切换为托盘运行，并通过托盘图标实现窗口显示与退出等快捷操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds system tray support for DSH Desktop, enabling minimize/close-to-tray behavior and tray icon actions to show the window or exit.

capabilities: Provides a system tray icon and tray menu interactions for the host app.
Supports minimizing and closing behavior changes to hide the main window into the system tray.
Performs startup-time patching and reinjection of host app files to keep tray support active after updates.

reasons.code: README states the plugin is for “系统托盘支持：常驻托盘图标 + 设置里开关最小化到托盘 / 关闭时隐藏到托盘”.

README lists direct file patching targets: resources/app/out/main/index.js, resources/app/out/preload/index.cjs, resources/app/package.json, and added out/main/tray-boot.js, indicating modification of installed app files.
README describes self-healing/update recovery behavior: on restart, the plugin re-injects patches and restores launcher/main entry after app updates.
Repository description summarizes “System tray support for DSH Desktop: tray icon plus settings... with self-healing boot-time injection.”
